observations.title: Most companies screen below their market price
observations.text: 23 of 24 DCF baselines are below market (median gap -42%). The defaults are conservative by construction (history-driven forecasts, no excess returns after year ten), so this measures expectations in prices more than mispricing. It should not be read as a set of sell calls.

observations.title: Terminal value dominates some valuations
observations.text: Terminal value is over 75% of enterprise value for AMBUJACEM, DALBHARAT, JKCEMENT. Where it does, the explicit forecast produces little cash and the result leans on the continuing-value assumptions.

observations.title: The price implies growth far outside history for some names
observations.text: Reconciling to market needs more than 30% a year, or no growth rate in the tested range, for MARICO, EICHERMOT, ULTRACEMCO, SHREECEM, AMBUJACEM, DALBHARAT, JKCEMENT. For these the single-driver reverse DCF is a blunt tool: margin expansion or a lower discount rate is the more plausible market view.

observations.title: Inputs that are reviewed by hand
observations.text: The G-sec yield and the equity risk premium are fixed in configuration with a source and a date. Neither is past its review date.
